title: Explorer console
responsibility: Loads recorded repository revisions and supplies the selected explorer screen with navigation, entities and evidence.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.base
inputs.description: URL prefix supplied to harnessClient and reused for generated explorer addresses and the screen media base. The value is concatenated with route paths and `/media/`.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.path
inputs.description: Address after base, including its query string. Its pathname and search select the current page and route scope.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.navigate
inputs.description: Host callback receiving a relative explorer address and a replace flag. It is called for user navigation, redirects, and canonical address corrections.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.links
inputs.description: Optional compatibility prop that is not destructured or rendered by this component. It defaults to undefined.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.content
inputs.description: Svelte screen component rendered after the index, selected revision, parent read, relationships, and answer cache are ready. It receives the selected route context, entities, lens, client, media base, and navigation callback.

inputs.name: HarnessConsole.projectsHref
inputs.description: The local Projects destination supplied by the Explorer. Embedders may omit it.

outputs.name: HarnessConsole
outputs.description: Rendered markup containing ExplorerLayout and, when the selected scope is ready, the supplied screen. While index or revision reads are pending it shows loading states; handled index and revision failures become refresh notices.

errors.name: Host navigation or screen error
errors.description: Exceptions from the host-provided navigate callback or supplied screen component are not caught by this component. Index and revision request failures are converted to notices, while activity and parent failures fall back to null.

inputs.name: consoleContentKey.location
inputs.description: Required route argument, which may be undefined while no screen is ready. Only branch, commit, category, screen, entity, helper, and section contribute to the key.

outputs.name: consoleContentKey
outputs.description: JSON string containing branch, commit, category, screen, entity, helper, and section in that order. Missing fields serialize as null, and all other location data is ignored.

inputs.name: consoleRelations.detail
inputs.description: Selected revision used for relationship lookup. Unit ids present in detail.registry.units use this revision's relationship reader.

inputs.name: consoleRelations.before
inputs.description: Parent revision used for ids absent from the selected revision. Null means the selected revision's reader is used for both present and absent ids.

inputs.name: consoleRelations.listed
inputs.description: Entities passed with the selected revision to its relationship reader. The list is used when resolving relationships for the selected revision.

outputs.name: consoleRelations
outputs.description: Returns a relationship callback that uses the selected revision for ids in detail.registry.units and otherwise uses the parent reader. If before is null, the selected revision reader is used for either case.

inputs.name: consoleView.index
inputs.description: Loaded history index retained by the returned lens for revision-bound history lookup. It is passed to explorerHistory when that lens method is called.

inputs.name: consoleView.scope
inputs.description: Selected route scope whose location is corrected against the supplied entities before the returned view is built. Its mode, commit, and parent also identify the revision context.

inputs.name: consoleView.loaded
inputs.description: The selected head revision and its parent, or null when no parent is available. These revisions are used to derive per-unit evidence for the returned lens.

inputs.name: consoleView.entities
inputs.description: Entities belonging to the selected revision context. They are used to correct the scope location before returning the view.

inputs.name: consoleView.relations
inputs.description: Relationship callback retained by the returned entity lens. The lens exposes it to consumers without invoking it during view construction.

inputs.name: consoleView.answers
inputs.description: Caller-owned Map keyed by unit id. A cached answer is reused; otherwise evidence and behavior are computed and stored when the lens first reads that unit.

inputs.name: consoleView.href
inputs.description: Address callback retained by the returned entity lens. It is invoked later by lens consumers when they need an explorer address.

outputs.name: consoleView
outputs.type: { index: HarnessIndex; scope: ExplorerScope; head: HarnessRevision; parent: HarnessRevision | null; lens: EntityLens }
outputs.description: Returns the history index, corrected scope, selected head and parent, and an EntityLens. The lens lazily computes and caches evidence and behavior by unit id, and retains the supplied relationship, address, and history behavior.
